name: Orric Josswyn
keeps: the crossing, and the six months between
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Organised a poisoning campaign against planters.
text: Orric josswyn of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 10th tranche, doors 86 to 95. Keeps the crossing, and the six months between. Reads François Makandal.
